item.title: Minister Healy-Rae launches €55 million scheme for private forests damaged by Storms Darragh and Éowyn
item.description: €55 million will be made available nationally to private forestry owners affected by storms Darragh and Éowyn through a new reconstitution scheme. Minister of State at the Department of Agriculture with special responsibility for Forestry, and Kerry TD, Michael Healy-Rae made the announcement. The scheme will provide financial aid to private landowners whose plantations were damaged by the storms. item.title: Kerry councillor calls for penalties for people using ambulance service for frivolous reasons
item.description: A Kerry County Councillor says there needs to be penalties for people who use the ambulance for frivolous reasons. Fine Gael councillor Angie Baily brought a motion on the issue before today’s monthly meeting of Kerry County Council. She's heard of cases whereby ambulances are used as a taxi service. item.title: Gardaí treating crash near Killarney as serious
item.description: It's understood that a crash near Killarney is being treated as a serious incident by gardaí. The collision occurred on the Lisivigeen roundabout on the N22 side of Killarney at around 4pm. Gardaí and Kerry County Council have closed the road between the Lisivigeen roundabout and Glenflesk. Advertisement Diversions are in place via Barraduff. Gardaí aren't commenting as to how many vehicles were involved. However, it's understood the crash is serious. Advertisement

item.title: Kerry County Council commits to four-week timeline for pre-planning feedback
item.description: Kerry County Council has committed to issuing pre-planning feedback to potential applicants in four weeks. The update was provided at the recent council meeting, in response to Independent councillor Johnny Healy-Rae. Cllr Johnny Healy-Rae asked the council to review the system for pre-planning meetings, and to introduce a set, realistic timeline for applicants and their agents. item.title: Manager has no idea if his Africa Cup of Nations players will be available Monday
item.description: Manchester United manager Ruben Amorim says he still has no idea if his Africa Cup of Nations players will be available for Monday's Premier League game with Bournemouth. Bryan Mbeumo, Noussair Mazraoui and Amad Diallo are all due to join up with their national teams before the upcoming tournament. Amorim also confirmed there is hope Benjamin Sesko could return for the game, although defenders Harry Maguire and Matthijs de Ligt remain sidelined through injury. Advertisement

item.title: Four Kerry animal welfare organisations to receive over €85,000 in funding
item.description: Four Kerry animal welfare organisations are to receive over €85,000 in funding. Nationally, 94 such organisations will get €6.43 million under the Animal Welfare Grants Programme. The Department of Agriculture stated that to be eligible, the organisations had to have a proven track record in rehoming, providing animal welfare education to the public, and guidance to prevent welfare problems in the future. item.title: Dave Connell appointed new manager of Wexford
item.description: Dave Connell has been appointed new manager of the Wexford Women's team. The former Galway United player left his role as head coach of the Republic of Ireland women's under-19s side, as part of recent staff cutbacks within the FAI. Wexford finished fourth in the League of Ireland Women's Premier Division in the season just gone. Advertisement

item.title: Former champion makes winning start at World Championship
item.description: Former champion Rob Cross says he's got "a lot more in the tank" after making a winning start at the World Darts Championship. He beat Cor Dekker 3-nil at Alexandra Palace to reach the second round. The 17th seed is confident of success this year Advertisement The first round continues tonight - Carlow's Steve Lennon take on Damon Heta.

item.title: Salah back in Liverpool squad
item.description: Mohamed Salah has been included in Liverpool's squad for tomorrow's Premier League fixture against Brighton. He was dropped for their Champions League win at Inter Milan after criticising the club in an interview last weekend. Salah met with manager Arne Slot today to discuss the situation. Advertisement
